name: rosetta-sorting-algorithms-selection-sort
code:
use default

selection_sort[T: Ghul.Comparable[T]](values: LIST[T]) is
    for i in 0..values.count - 1 do
        let smallest mut = i

        for j in i + 1..values.count do
            if values[j] < values[smallest] then
                smallest = j
            fi
        od

        (values[i], values[smallest]) = (values[smallest], values[i])
    od
si

let numbers = LIST([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2, 7])

selection_sort(numbers)

write_line(numbers |> join(", "))

let words = LIST(["pear", "apple", "quince", "banana"])

selection_sort(words)

write_line(words |> join(", "))
